# Reviewed under AGENTS.md

from __future__ import annotations


def slugify(title: str) -> str:
    """Convert a title into a URL-friendly slug.

    The transformation is applied in this order: lowercase the title, replace
    ``&`` with `` and ``, drop every character that is not an ASCII letter,
    digit, space or hyphen, collapse runs of spaces and hyphens into a single
    hyphen, strip hyphens from both ends, and finally truncate to 40
    characters, stripping any trailing hyphen left by the cut.
    """
    slug = title.lower()
    slug = slug.replace('&', ' and ')
    slug = ''.join(c for c in slug if c.isascii() and (c.isalnum() or c in ' -'))
    slug = '-'.join(part for part in slug.replace('-', ' ').split(' ') if part)
    slug = slug.strip('-')
    if len(slug) > 40:
        slug = slug[:40].rstrip('-')
    return slug
